verdict.rationale: WooCommerce is open-source and self-hosted, and promises "full control" of your data. All store data can be read as JSON through the REST API and its official client libraries, and the WC-CLI can also reach it, so a full programmatic export in an open format is possible. However, no first-party bulk export or 'take your data and leave' feature is documented, and the migration guides only cover moving onto WooCommerce, not off it. Missing for 10: a documented one-click or bulk export of all store data (e.g. CSV/JSON dumps of products, orders, customers), any documented exit or migration-away path, and independent or hands-on confirmation of a complete export.
